card.name: Start, stop, or stay on therapy
card.fires_on: Verbs and short linking words about beginning, continuing, or stopping treatment, such as initiating, starting, continuing, stop, on, or of. They come just before words like therapy or treatment in warnings and precautions.

modes.label: Beginning treatment
modes.description: Words like initiating or starting right before therapy or treatment, often after before, prior to, or who are.
modes.example: Screen all patients for HBV infection by measuring HBsAg and anti-HBc before<< initiating>> treatment with GAZYVA.

modes.label: Continuing or stopping
modes.description: Words such as continuing, stop, on, or of that refer to ongoing, resumed, or ended therapy.
modes.example: If signs and symptoms of tardive dyskinesia appear in a patient<< on>> antipsychotics, drug discontinuation

card.writes: It adds therapy-related nouns such as steroids and ACE as likely next words, with weak or unclear effects otherwise.
card.plain: It marks the point in a warning where the text refers to starting, continuing, or stopping a drug.
